# The change this fixture has a design for

## Problem

A conformance run needs one governed path a design covers and one that none does, so that `allow`
and `deny` are told apart by the rule rather than by the path being governed at all.

## Approach

This design covers `src/covered.py` and nothing else. `src/other.py` is governed and uncovered.

## Pillars

- P1 applies — this design is what makes `src/covered.py` a covered path.

## Deviations

none

## Dependencies

None added.

## Levers

- `test-the-contract` — the fixture is a real repository, and the cases are real events.
